item.text:
“the stakes for our coverage has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our coverage have never been higher”

“federal goverment's” >>> “federal government's”

“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”

“three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]

“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”

“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”

“In brief, the bill:” >>> “In brief:”

“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”

“directly effect every company” >>> “directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier. Confirm the state.]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The bill summary places the vessel registry in Section 4, not Section 5.]

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty” >>> [CHECK: The bill summary gives a maximum daily civil penalty of $1 million. Confirm the amount and whether the amendment changes it.]

“who's support” >>> “whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”

“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These counts total 29, but the committee is said to have 28 members.]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow.” >>> [CHECK: Five senators are listed, but the preceding sentence says six are undecided.]

“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”

“a seperate interview” >>> “a separate interview”

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached.” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached.”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“the week November 16” >>> “the week of November 16”

“occured on September 30” >>> “occurred on September 30”

“The committee's hearing on the impacts of deep-sea mining occured on September 30” >>> [CHECK: The votes section refers to a September 23 hearing. Confirm whether these are separate hearings or conflicting dates for the same hearing.]

“the treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary specifies 18 months, not two years.]

“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“there senators” >>> “their senators”

“recieve updated notes” >>> “receive updated notes”

“Each of our five Hill reporters” >>> [CHECK: The coverage plan earlier says there are six Hill reporters. Confirm the number or clarify whether only five will file live-blog items.]
